mapper.select: SELECT C.CI_SN AS CI_ID, C.CI_SE_CD AS SE_CD, C.CI_TTL AS TITLE, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = C.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FILE_URL, ( SELECT F.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = C.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FILE_NAME FROM HMPG_CI C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.CI_SE_CD ASC, C.SORT_SEQ ASC, C.CI_SN ASC
